findings: Front-cap UVs stretched white pigment into radial wedges, fin UVs elongated the spots, the grid was too regular and pelvic outlines folded.

changes: Project the closed snout UVs, bake fin pigment from physical coordinates, vary original spot placement/size and correct pelvic outlines; view actual whole-body, side-head and frontal renders and pass current source/import/browser gates.

visual_checks.anatomy: pass: broad flattened snout, tiny lateral eyes, five gill-slit relief marks per flank and subtle longitudinal ridges
visual_checks.surface: pass: varied original pale spots and thin body grid; projected snout and physical-coordinate fin pigment avoid the former radial/stretched pattern
visual_checks.head: pass: distinct closed anterior lip on the real broad snout, reviewed from the front
visual_checks.fins: pass: closed opaque swept cartilage fins, distinct paired pelvics, two dorsals and unequal caudal lobes
visual_checks.surface_contact: pass: source and actual imported GLB retain five-phase root contact
visual_checks.motion: pass: restrained body/tail and fin cycle survive actual GLB import with matching endpoints

limitations: Original photo-informed Rhincodon typus artwork, not a scanned or calibrated specimen.
The mouth is closed; filter feeding, fine denticles and teeth are simplified. Gill slits use shallow relief and motion is artist-tuned.
